reviewer: Independent AI-assisted mathematical/editorial review; not human or formal certification
basis: These routes record the easiest defensible statement-and-options path, including explicit demotions and normalized-capacity caveats. They are independently authored, not copied author difficulty estimates.

families.easiestOptionsVisibleRoute: At the first case use periodic residue weights directly; generally reduce the fourth sine power to two known cosine Fourier sums.

families.difficultyRationale: Hard: the periodic first case and general finite-angle formula offer a routine shortest route.

families.difficultyRationale: Olympiad hidden scale telescope; explicit multiplication repairs prevent the old denominator ambiguity.

families.easiestOptionsVisibleRoute: Average three exponential evaluations at cubic roots of unity and combine the conjugate pair.
